concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Concept inspected. Retain a single gentle S-shaped fill with quiet surrounding rock and homogeneous solid end. Correct any apparent carved trench/outer pale wall: fill must meet unlined host directly; no raised sheath or broad halo. Use about12mm diameter, modest half-embedded relief and two broad turns rather than tight repeated U loops. A visible end cut is illustrative, not a claimed excavated exposure. Both ends may meet slab edge, and host/trace share a seamless boundary in one closed surface with no hidden stacked slab faces. Smooth faceted tube remains readable in top and clay; do not rotate or reuse a Skolithos mesh.
